question: how do i report a post
answer: Open the post's menu (the three dots) and choose Report. A moderator will review it. You can report student posts; staff announcements are not reportable.

question: how do i report a comment or reply
answer: Open the comment or reply, tap its menu, and choose Report. A moderator reviews reported content and decides whether to remove it.

question: what is a post flair
answer: A flair is a category label on a post, like Lost & Found. Pick one when you create a post. The Announcement flair is reserved for teachers, moderators, and admins.

question: can i post anonymously
answer: Yes. Turn on Post Anonymously when creating a post. Other students see you as Anonymous, but admins and moderators can still see who posted.

question: who can see my anonymous post
answer: Other students see it as Anonymous. Admins and moderators can still see your real identity, so anonymous posting is not fully hidden from staff.

question: how do i use the ai assistant in a post
answer: Mention @BondedAI anywhere in a post or comment. Once the post is approved, the assistant adds a reply. You can also chat with it directly on the AI chat screen.

question: what is lost and found
answer: Use the Lost & Found flair when you lost or found something on campus. Describe the item in your post. When it is returned or claimed, the original poster can mark it resolved.

question: how do i mark a lost item as found
answer: If you made the Lost & Found post, open it and confirm when the assistant or a commenter indicates the item was found, returned, or claimed.

question: why is my post pending
answer: Every new post is checked before it appears. Pending means the automatic check or a moderator is still reviewing it. It will appear once approved.

question: why was my post removed
answer: A moderator removed it because it was reported or flagged as breaking the community rules. Check your notifications for details, or contact a moderator.

question: how do i save a post
answer: Tap the bookmark icon on a post to save it. Open the Bookmarks screen to see everything you have saved.

question: how do i find my saved posts
answer: Open the Bookmarks screen from the menu. It lists every post you have bookmarked.

question: how do i create a poll
answer: Open Create Poll, type your question, and add two or more options. Other users vote and see the results.

question: what is a server or channel
answer: Servers are community spaces you can join. Each server has channels for different topics. You can post in a channel or to the campus-wide Home feed.

question: how do i join a server
answer: Open the server list, pick a server, and join it. After joining you can read and post in its channels.

question: how do i edit or delete my post
answer: Open your post's menu and choose Edit or Delete. You can only edit or delete posts you created. Edited posts are checked again before they reappear.

question: how do i tag someone in a post
answer: Type @ followed by their name while writing your post, then pick them from the list. Type @everyone to notify everyone in that space.

question: when do i get a notification
answer: You are notified when someone mentions you, replies to you, comments on your post, or reacts to your post. Safety alerts also go to moderators.

question: what roles exist in bonded
answer: BondED has students, teachers, moderators, and admins. Some actions, like posting Announcements and reviewing reports, are limited to staff roles.

question: what are the user types or roles
answer: BondED accounts are students, teachers, moderators, or admins. Teachers, moderators, and admins are staff and can do things students cannot, like post Announcements and review reports.

question: who reviews reported content
answer: Moderators, teachers, and admins review reports in the moderation queue and decide whether content stays or is removed.

question: is my data private
answer: Your profile details like your student ID and email are never shown by the assistant. Only your first and last name are shown when your name is needed.

question: how do i contact a moderator
answer: Post in your class or server and mention the issue, or use a Report so a moderator sees it. Serious safety concerns are escalated to staff automatically.
